title: Suite
identity: IRCAM identifies Paul Dessau’s Suite for alto saxophone and piano, composed in 1935, about 10 minutes, with four movements. Boosey & Hawkes lists the 1989 premiere in Berlin, recommends the Frank Lunte/Tatjana Blome recording and gives a shorter duration of eight minutes. Publisher and institutional records differ on duration; do not force a correction.

evidence.claim: Identifies 1935 composition, alto sax/piano, 10 minutes, four movement titles and 1989 first performance date.
Lists alto/piano, 8 minutes, world premiere 31 March 1989 by Detlef Bensmann and Michael Rische; recommended EDA 022 recording.

review_focus: Review the four named movement characters and full-suite endurance; timing conflict and 1935 composition date vs 1989 publication/performance are to be retained.
collection_flag: Original saxophone and piano suite is documented by IRCAM and publisher; no pedagogical placement found.
